The '''P-series droideka''' or '''P-series destroyer droid''' was a model of [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] produced by the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and later for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

Several P-series droidekas were stationed aboard the Federation [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], and they were also deployed during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of the Great Grass Plains]] against the native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].

Several P-series droidekas remained on Lok after the Trade Federation utilized it as a testing zone for their assault on the planet of Naboo, in addition to other B1 model droids.

Swift and deadly, the P-series was nevertheless obsolete by the [[22 BBY/Legends|time]] of the Battle of Geonosis, during which the more advanced [[W-series droideka/Legends|W-series]] was also deployed.

Although it could not use its [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] while in "wheel" mode, the P-series became largely invulnerable once it unfolded into its upright firing stance. It even stymied the resourceful and powerful [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who abandoned their immediate task and fled when faced with these "destroyers" aboard [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']]. The deflector shield generators, however, were not immune to heavy artillery, as demonstrated when Anakin destroyed three P-series droids with a Naboo starfighter. In addition, even an unfolded Droideka could be disabled if it was hit with a surprise shot, as evidenced by one being accidentally taken down by Jar Jar Binks via blaster fire during the Battle of Naboo before it had the chance to activate its deflector shield due to Binks' foot being entangled with a severed battle droid's wiring at the time.<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref>
